message.content: On February 24, 1815, the young sailor Edmond Dantès, aboard the *Pharaon* as acting captain following Captain Leclère’s death, arrives in Marseilles to great anticipation—only to face suspicion from the envious supercargo Danglars over an unauthorized stop at Elba and a secret packet delivered to Marshal Bertrand, while shipowner Morrel expresses confidence in promoting him to permanent captain and hints at his imminent marriage to Mercédès—unaware that Dantès’s fate is already shifting toward betrayal and imprisonment.
